method: Production MapLibre v5.6.2 private StyleLayerIndex and WorkerTile.parse exposed in an isolated runtime; original source parser/grouping/bucket code, real shipped PBF, fixed subdivision granularity 1. No network or GPU; isolated parse timings are observations, not browser latency claims.

checks.name: Real worker groups ordinary and independent selected layers with their respective base layers
Real populated bucket objects and geometry arrays are identical for each base/selection pair
Sharing leaves every ordinary and independent geometry vertex and triangle byte unchanged
Every shipped tile feature matches exactly one selected layer, including XX composites
Both selected passes retain original color, width, opacity and state dependency
